latestVersion.changelog:
Focus Session Timer 1.0.0

- Initial release introduces a descriptive framework for planning focused work or study sessions.
- Helps users select session mode (Quick Sprint, Standard Focus, Deep Work Block) based on task and context.
- Provides structured prompts for defining session goals, visible finish lines, and recovery from interruptions.
- Returns a markdown focus card with session outline, start ritual, distraction capture, break plan, and end review.
- Does not include any actual timer or automation features—guidance only.
